NAME=Audio\Generated distortion\Alien alternating detune
NOTE=SM64 US v1.0 / compatible US-based extensions only. Alternates notes a half-semitone flat and sharp for an uneven alien tuning. Changes gNoteFrequencies (80333994). New notes use the changed ratios; sampled/percussion sounds may be unaffected. Select one Audio effect at a time. Enable after boot.
